events.title: Curbline Properties acquires 62 centers for $715.2 million
events.summary: Curbline Properties Corp. announced the acquisition of 62 convenience shopping centers for a total of $715.2 million from January through September 11, 2026. This includes 18 properties purchased for $198.6 million in the third quarter alone, funded by cash on hand and equity settlements. The company's CEO, David R. Lukes, noted a continued strong pipeline of opportunities.

articles.headline: Curbline Properties acquires 62 centers for $715.2 million

events.title: Marathon Petroleum stock hits all-time high at 409.63 USD By Investing.com
events.summary: Marathon Petroleum Corp (MPC) reached an all-time high of $409.63, with its stock currently trading at $410.68, just 1% below its 52-week high, and an impressive year-to-date return of 147%. This surge follows strong Q2 2026 financial results that surpassed Wall Street expectations, attributed to robust operations, favorable market conditions, and effective crude sourcing. Despite being considered overvalued by InvestingPro analysis, the company has received upgrades and increased price targets from analysts, fueled by sustained high refining margins and rising oil prices amidst Middle East tensions.

articles.headline: Marathon Petroleum stock hits all-time high at 409.63 USD By Investing.com

events.title: Rollins Inc stock hits 52-week low at 34.34 USD
events.summary: Rollins Inc. (ROL) stock has fallen to a 52-week low of $34.34, representing a 37.81% decrease over the past year. Despite its current P/E ratio of 31.3 and being considered undervalued by InvestingPro, the company faces challenges including weaker-than-expected residential business performance, leading to lowered price targets and downgrades from analysts like Piper Sandler, Wells Fargo, and JPMorgan. Rollins Inc. has maintained dividend payments for 56 consecutive years, showcasing financial stability despite recent downturns.

articles.headline: Rollins Inc stock hits 52-week low at 34.34 USD By Investing.com

events.title: Valero Stock Up 140%, On Track For Best Year In Its History - Valero Energy (NYSE:VLO)
events.summary: Valero Energy Corp. (NYSE: VLO) has seen its stock climb 140.6% year-to-date, putting it on track for its best year ever, surpassing 2005's record. This surge is largely attributed to a diesel squeeze, with the ultra-low-sulfur diesel crack spread near $106 a barrel due to disruptions, Russian export bans, and winter restocking. Valero and Marathon Petroleum Corp. (NYSE: MPC) have both doubled refining margins and are among the top-performing S&P 500 stocks.

articles.headline: Valero Stock Up 140%, On Track For Best Year In Its History - Valero Energy (NYSE:VLO)

events.title: Smartphone Chip Stocks Rally While Large-Cap Technology Slips: Skyworks Jumps 11%, Qorvo Rises 7%, Qualcomm Climbs 4%
events.summary: Smartphone chip stocks like Skyworks, Qorvo, and Qualcomm saw significant rallies, with Skyworks jumping 11%, Qorvo rising 7%, and Qualcomm climbing 4%, despite a broader slip in large-cap technology. This divergence highlights a shift in semiconductor investment towards handset-focused radio frequency (RF) chip names, driven by factors like pending mergers and seasonal product launches rather than AI data center spending. The rally for these specific stocks suggests a distinct market movement independent of the broader tech sector's performance.

articles.headline: Smartphone Chip Stocks Rally While Large-Cap Technology Slips: Skyworks Jumps 11%, Qorvo Rises 7%, Qualcomm Climbs 4%

events.title: Chevron’s CEO Thinks the World Is Out of Spare Oil. He Is Betting $7 Billion on Being Right.
events.summary: Chevron's CEO, Mike Wirth, believes that the world's emergency oil reserves are depleted and cannot be replenished indefinitely, making crude oil vulnerable to disruptions. To back this conviction, Chevron is investing $7 billion in a Venezuelan expansion project, aiming to more than double output there, funded entirely by in-country cash flow. This strategy allows Chevron to capitalize on potential oil shortages without diverting capital from other key projects, positioning the company favorably amidst rising oil prices and resilient demand.

articles.headline: Chevron’s CEO Thinks the World Is Out of Spare Oil. He Is Betting $7 Billion on Being Right.

events.title: Moody’s to buy minority stake in PhilRatings
events.summary: Moody's Corp. has announced its agreement to acquire a minority stake in Philippine Rating Services Corp. (PhilRatings). This investment makes Moody’s Ratings the first global credit rating agency to invest in a domestic rating agency in the Philippines, aiming to capitalize on the growing demand for financing and the potential of the domestic bond market. PhilRatings will maintain its independence in operations, management, governance, and credit rating processes following the investment, while benefiting from Moody’s technical support and international best practices.

articles.headline: Moody’s to buy minority stake in PhilRatings

events.title: AMD, Skyworks among market cap stock movers on Tuesday By Investing.com
events.summary: On Tuesday, several stocks experienced significant movements, with Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) and Skyworks Solutions (SWKS) seeing notable gains. Conversely, Oracle Corp (ORCL) and Enova International Inc (ENVA) were among those experiencing declines. These shifts were attributed to a combination of corporate news and broader market trends, affecting companies across mega-cap, large-cap, mid-cap, and small-cap categories.

articles.headline: AMD, Skyworks among market cap stock movers on Tuesday By Investing.com

events.title: Coca-Cola report shows $85B U.S. economic impact across foodservice, retail and more
events.summary: A new independent study commissioned by The Coca-Cola Company reveals its system contributes $85 billion to the U.S. GDP and supports nearly 1 million jobs annually. The company also plans to invest $10 billion in U.S. infrastructure from 2026 through 2030, underscoring its significant economic impact and commitment to local communities across America.

articles.headline: Coca-Cola report shows $85B U.S. economic impact across foodservice, retail and more

events.title: Moody's London HQ Building at 10 Gresham Street Hits the Market
events.summary: Moody's Corporation's London headquarters at 10 Gresham Street is being put up for sale, with CBRE Group Inc. marketing the property for around £330 million ($445 million). The sale serves as a critical test for London's office market, which has seen a slowdown in large asset deals due to rising interest rates and geopolitical events. The building previously sold for £200 million in 2012 to a Malaysian state pension fund, and its current sale will indicate current demand for prime City office spaces amid shifting tenant preferences between the City and Canary Wharf.

articles.headline: Moody's London HQ Building at 10 Gresham Street Hits the Market

events.title: Brookfield Renewable Partners offers a 4.51% yield—but can that payout keep income investors confident for the long haul?
events.summary: Brookfield Renewable Partners (TSX:BEP.UN) offers a 4.51% dividend yield, appealing to income investors due to its diversified renewable power assets and contracted cash flows. The article analyzes the sustainability of its dividend, highlighting growth drivers like global electrification and strategic acquisitions, while also discussing risks such as rising interest rates and project execution challenges. Despite potential market volatility, the partnership's long-term outlook remains positive for investors seeking exposure to the clean energy transition.

articles.headline: Brookfield Renewable Partners offers a 4.51% yield—but can that payout keep income investors confident for the long haul?

events.title: HCA Healthcare completes acquisition of health college CHCP
events.summary: HCA Healthcare Inc. (NYSE:HCA) has announced the completion of its acquisition of The College of Health Care Professions (CHCP). CHCP serves over 8,000 students across 10 campuses in Texas and online, offering more than 20 accredited healthcare programs. This acquisition expands HCA Healthcare's educational offerings, which already include several nursing colleges and over 365 Graduate Medical Education programs.

articles.headline: HCA Healthcare completes acquisition of health college CHCP

events.title: Fixed Income ETFs Surge to All-Time Highs Ahead of Pivotal Fed Decision
events.summary: Fixed income ETFs have experienced record-breaking net inflows of $446 billion in 2026, surpassing all-time annual levels with months remaining in the year. This surge is attributed to wealth managers shifting from mutual funds to ETFs for their liquidity, efficiency, and tax advantages, particularly with ultra-short cash proxies dominating inflows as the Federal Reserve convenes for its September policy meeting. Investors are actively positioning themselves across the yield curve, utilizing ETFs to navigate potential rate hikes and broader market uncertainty.

articles.headline: Fixed Income ETFs Surge to All-Time Highs Ahead of Pivotal Fed Decision

events.title: ADP National Employment Report Preliminary Estimate for August 29, 2026
events.summary: ADP's latest NER Pulse report indicates that U.S. private employers added an average of 16,250 jobs per week for the four weeks ending August 29, 2026, marking the second consecutive week of increased hiring. These preliminary figures, based on high-frequency, seasonally adjusted data, are subject to change as more information becomes available. The report is produced by ADP Research in collaboration with the Stanford Digital Economy Lab.

articles.headline: ADP National Employment Report Preliminary Estimate for August 29, 2026

events.title: Sysco Shares Fall 1.3% After Pricing $1 Billion Stock Offering
events.summary: Sysco (NYSE:SYY) shares fell 1.3% after pricing a $1 billion common stock offering at a discount to finance its $29.1 billion acquisition of Jetro Restaurant Depot. The offering of 12,345,679 shares at $81 each will result in dilution for existing shareholders and expand Sysco's presence in the cash-and-carry foodservice distribution market. Sysco has also paused its share repurchase program to prioritize debt reduction following the acquisition.

articles.headline: Sysco Shares Fall 1.3% After Pricing $1 Billion Stock Offering

events.title: Union Pacific stock edges higher as analysts highlight earnings beat and dividend growth
events.summary: Union Pacific's stock is trading near the upper end of its 12-month range following a recent earnings beat and a dividend increase. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average 12-month price target of approximately $320.89, highlighting the company's double-digit revenue growth and consistent shareholder returns. Institutional ownership remains high, indicating confidence in Union Pacific as a core holding in the U.S. transportation sector.

articles.headline: Union Pacific stock edges higher as analysts highlight earnings beat and dividend growth

events.title: New offer for consumers proposed in possible Dominion Energy merger
events.summary: Dominion Energy and NextEra have proposed a new offer for consumers as part of their pending $67 billion merger. The updated offer extends a $10 monthly bill credit to four years, removing the previous credit for data centers. Despite the enhancement, consumer advocates argue the changes do not provide long-term protection or address underlying regulatory issues causing bill increases, while state regulators face a mid-January deadline for approval.

articles.headline: New offer for consumers proposed in possible Dominion Energy merger

events.title: Bio-Techne issues supplemental merger disclosures amid shareholder lawsuit By Investing.com
events.summary: Bio-Techne has released supplemental disclosures regarding its pending merger with Merck KGaA following a shareholder lawsuit and multiple demand letters alleging misrepresentations or omissions in its proxy statement. The lawsuit seeks to prevent the shareholder vote scheduled for September 23. Despite believing the allegations lack merit, Bio-Techne is voluntarily providing this additional information to mitigate litigation risks and ensure the vote proceeds.

articles.headline: Bio-Techne issues supplemental merger disclosures amid shareholder lawsuit By Investing.com

events.title: 'They Don't Call It an Extra Value Meal for Nothing': McDonald's Pitches $8 Big Macs as Diesel Hits $6.23
events.summary: McDonald's is promoting an $8 Big Mac meal to attract customers while facing record-high diesel prices, which are driving up supply chain costs for franchisees. This strategy collides with McDonald's Q2 FY2026 earnings showing decelerated global comparable sales and negative U.S. guest counts, leading to a 14% year-to-date stock drop. CEO Chris Kempczinski admitted to execution issues and a slow recovery, noting that about a third of locations didn't follow value pricing recommendations.

articles.headline: 'They Don't Call It an Extra Value Meal for Nothing': McDonald's Pitches $8 Big Macs as Diesel Hits $6.23

events.title: Chip Equipment Stocks Slide as AI Pacing Call Reaches Fab Spending: Applied Materials and Lam Research Fall 6%, ASML Sinks 5%
events.summary: Chip equipment stocks, including Applied Materials, Lam Research, and ASML, experienced significant drops (around 5-6%) after AI CEOs suggested slowing the pace of AI model development. This debate about AI pacing is impacting the equipment order books before affecting current chip shipments, causing the "tools layer" of the semiconductor industry to fall harder than the broader market. Despite recent record revenues and strong guidance from these companies, the market is questioning the sustainability of their growth rates given the potential shift in AI capital expenditure.

articles.headline: Chip Equipment Stocks Slide as AI Pacing Call Reaches Fab Spending: Applied Materials and Lam Research Fall 6%, ASML Sinks 5%
